newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian UCB kept in check ahead results.
newsitem.headline: Belgian UCB kept in check ahead results.

text.p: Belgian drugs, chemicals and plastics films group UCB barely budged on the Brussels bourse due to high expectations about first half 1997 earnings due later on Wednesday, dealers said.
At 0930 GMT, UCB, one of the most volatile Belgian shares in recent months, was up 0.5 percent at 140,750 francs and moving in a tight 2,000-franc range.
Analysts expect UCB to announce a 30 to 35 percent first-half profit increase.
"UCB is already very expensive and the market is expecting at least 35 percent for it to rise further," one trader said.
"Between 30 and 35 (percent) the market will not be euphoric. Anything more will be seen as positive, but the market will be very disappointed if it's just 25 to 30 percent," the trader said.
Generale Bank gave a hold recommendation for UCB in its daily equity focus investor note on Wednesday.
UCB began to take off at the end of May, when it was at 95,600 francs, peaking at 153,000 on July 17.
